culprit_citations.quoted_text: Aviation Technical Services, Inc. First Lien Senior Secured Loan ... Cost $ 16,833 ... Market Value $ 16,824

findings.detail: The source schedule presents BDC valuation Cost and Market Value as dollar amounts, but the extracted cost_currency is the noncanonical unit label U_USD instead of USD.

rationale: FX03 is a Class 1 currency-field validation. The raw Schedule of Investments row has dollar-denominated Cost and Market Value columns for the flagged BDC valuation fields, while the extracted field under review stores cost_currency as U_USD. That is a localized currency/unit normalization error rather than an ambiguous source issue.
